content.old: We rounded up five well-reviewed pumpkin carving kits on Amazon, from a budget basic set to a deluxe kit with lights.
content.new: We rounded up five pumpkin carving kits on Amazon for adults planning a family pumpkin-decorating night.

content.old: The five picks below cover little kids, beginners, and folks who carve a whole row of porch pumpkins every October.
content.new: Adults can handle the carving while small children help with designs, decorating and scooping out pulp and seeds.

content.old: The all-rounder: 22 stainless pieces with 15 stencils and a carry bag that keeps it all together until next October. Serrated blades cut cleanly through thick pumpkin walls, and it’s a top-100 seller in its category for a reason — a strong pick when the whole family wants in on pumpkin night.
content.new: The NFEVER kit includes seven stainless steel carving tools, 15 stencils and a carrying bag. Its advertised 22-piece count combines the tools and stencils; it does not mean 22 steel tools.

content.old: Safety first for little hands. Kid-safe kits use serrated plastic saws that cut pumpkin but not skin. Keep the sharp detail tools for the grown-ups.
content.new: Safety first. No cutting tool should be treated as injury-proof. The American Academy of Pediatrics advises letting small children decorate pumpkins and leaving carving and cutting to adults. Follow each manufacturer’s age restrictions and warnings.

content.old: Don’t forget the light. Kits that include battery LED candles or flameless lights mean the pumpkin glows all night without a fire worry on a dry October porch.
content.new: Don’t forget the light. Consider a battery-operated flameless candle or flashlight instead of an open flame. Check whether a light is included or must be purchased separately.
